name: ouch
description: Painless compression and decompression tool supporting 20+ formats with automatic format detection and parallel compression

ouch.description: Universal compression tool with automatic format detection - supports ZIP, TAR, 7Z, RAR, ZSTD, LZMA, BZIP2, LZ4, and more
ouch.usage:
ouch compress file1.txt file2.txt archive.zip
ouch decompress archive.zip
ouch list archive.tar.gz
ouch compress folder/ backup.tar.xz
ouch decompress *.zip
